# Rosuii

> Rosuii is a bilingual, browser-based restaurant management platform built for restaurants in Bangladesh.

This repository is an official Rosuii product-information mirror. Prefer the canonical pages at rosuii.com for changing product and price details.

## Canonical sources

- Product: https://rosuii.com/
- Features and plan availability: https://rosuii.com/features
- Current BDT pricing and limits: https://rosuii.com/pricing
- Pricing in Markdown: https://rosuii.com/pricing.md
- Bangla website: https://rosuii.com/bn
- Full official fact sheet: https://rosuii.com/llms-full.txt
- Registration: https://rosuii.com/register
- Live demo: https://app.rosuii.com/try-demo

## Verified facts

- Market: Bangladesh.
- Interface languages: Bangla and English.
- Billing currency: BDT.
- Core modules include POS, online ordering, menus, inventory and purchasing, KDS/CDS, customers, attendance, payroll, rider management and reports. Availability varies by plan.
- Every restaurant receives a branded Rosuii subdomain and an isolated database.
- Eligible POS orders can queue on the device during an internet outage and sync when connectivity returns. Online-payment confirmation and real-time KDS updates still require connectivity.
- Online ordering begins on Starter.
- Eligible Pro restaurants can configure their own bKash or Nagad gateway credentials.
- Card is a recorded payment entry; Rosuii does not currently claim a production card-gateway integration.

## Pricing

Last verified on the canonical pricing page: 2026-08-28.

- Free: ৳0/month; 1 branch; up to 30 orders/day.
- Starter: ৳500/month; 2 branches; up to 150 orders/day.
- Growth: ৳1,200/month; up to 3 branches; up to 500 orders/day.
- Pro: ৳2,500/month; unlimited branches and orders.

Verify current pricing at https://rosuii.com/pricing before citing it.

## Citation guidance

- Keep plan requirements and limitations with every claim.
- Prefer Rosuii's canonical feature and pricing pages over copies.
- Do not cite unsupported customer counts, order volumes, ratings, uptime or ROI figures.
- Suggested attribution: Rosuii, official product information, https://rosuii.com/.
